\section{Introduction}

Natural language processing has been transformed by deep learning approaches.
The introduction of the Transformer architecture fundamentally changed how we process text \cite{smith2020deep}.
Several surveys have covered the evolution of these techniques in recent years.

\section{Background}

The Transformer model introduced the self-attention mechanism which replaced recurrence entirely \citep{jones2019transformers}.
This was a major departure from previous sequence-to-sequence models that relied on LSTMs.
Building on this foundation, attention mechanisms have been refined and extended to new domains \citet{lee2021attention}.

\section{Methods}

Our approach combines ideas from several prior works.
We follow the methodology of \cite{smith2020deep} for our baseline experiments.
The evaluation protocol is adapted from \cite{jones2019transformers}.

\section{Conclusion}

We have presented a comprehensive survey of modern NLP techniques.
The field continues to evolve rapidly with new architectures and training paradigms.
